source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of tree applications (PDF 112-113).

items: File systems: pre-order traversal file system ka backup banane mein kaam aata hai. Pehle root aur phir har directory (folder) ka dobara (recursively) backup lene se har folder us ke andar ke saman se pehle backup hota hai.
File system se mitana: post-order traversal se files aur folders sahi order (tarteeb) mein mitte hain: pehle andar ke saare sub-folders aur files, phir parent (bahar wala) folder.

Hierarchical data (oopar-neeche darjon wala data) dikhana: jahan data mein saaf oopar-neeche ka rishta ho, jaise kisi organisation (idare) ka organisational chart ya family tree, wahan trees istemal hote hain.
Faisla karna (decision making): decision trees jaise trees algorithms mein alag alag conditions (shartein) aur outcomes (nateeje) ki base par faisla karne ke liye istemal hote hain.
Syntax parsing: programming languages mein source code ki banawat (syntax) ko samajhne aur dikhane ke liye trees bante hain; is se compiler code ki banawat samajh kar use process karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Folder aur us ka saara saman mitane ke liye post-order kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Folder tabhi mit sakta hai jab woh khali ho, aur post-order parent se pehle us ke saare children dekhta (mitata) hai.

items: Tree ke istemal: backup (pre-order), mitana (post-order), hierarchy, decision trees, compilers.
